definitions.gloss: medical treatment; therapy; procedure (especially hands-on therapies)
definitions.explanation: A treatment or therapeutic procedure, often referring to massage, acupuncture, chiropractic care, or cosmetic procedures rather than major surgery.

examples.japanese: {施術|せじゅつ}{時間|じかん}は{約|やく}{一|いち}{時間|じかん}です。
examples.english: The treatment time is about one hour.

examples.japanese: {経験|けいけん}{豊富|ほうふ}な{施術者|せじゅつしゃ}が{丁寧|ていねい}にマッサージをしてくれた。
examples.english: An experienced practitioner gave me a careful massage.

notes:
Commonly used in the context of massage therapy, acupuncture, chiropractic care, beauty treatments, and other hands-on therapeutic practices. Less formal than {手術|しゅじゅつ} (surgery), which refers to invasive surgical procedures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {施術|せじゅつ}を{受|う}ける: to receive treatment
- {施術|せじゅつ}を{行|おこな}う: to perform a treatment
- {施術者|せじゅつしゃ}: practitioner, therapist
- {施術|せじゅつ}{時間|じかん}: treatment time
- {施術|せじゅつ}{後|ご}: after treatment

PRONUNCIATION:
Also read as {施術|しじゅつ}, though せじゅつ is more common in modern usage, especially in healthcare and beauty contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {手術|しゅじゅつ}: surgery — invasive surgical procedures performed by doctors
- {治療|ちりょう}: medical treatment — broader term covering all types of medical care
- {処置|しょち}: treatment, procedure — often emergency or routine medical measures
